summary: Static site built with Astro and served free from Cloudflare Pages; no backend or database to run.

frontend.justification: Pre-renders pages to static HTML with zero JS by default. Fit for this project: team.languages includes JavaScript; well suited to content site projects; strong cost for Astro (priority 5); seo_critical=true and it serves pre-rendered HTML.

alternatives.why_not: Scored 26.8 points lower: the chosen option wins on project.type (well suited to content site projects).
Scored 6.3 points lower: app framework is heavier than this content site needs; the chosen option wins on project.type (well suited to content site projects).

tradeoffs: Rich app-like interactivity needs islands; large SPAs are a poor fit.

backend.justification: The site has no server-side logic. Fit for this project: static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for; strong cost for None (priority 5); strong time to market for None (priority 4); strong maintainability for None (priority 3).

alternatives.why_not: Scored 23.8 points lower: a server is unnecessary for a static content site; the chosen option wins on project.type (static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for).
Scored 24.9 points lower: a server is unnecessary for a static content site; the chosen option wins on project.type (static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for).

database.justification: Content lives in the repository as Markdown files. Fit for this project: content is Markdown in the repository; no database to run; strong cost for None (priority 5); strong time to market for None (priority 4); strong maintainability for None (priority 3).

alternatives.why_not: Scored 20.8 points lower: a database is unnecessary for static content; the chosen option wins on project.type (content is Markdown in the repository; no database to run).
Scored 23.9 points lower: a database is unnecessary for static content; the chosen option wins on project.type (content is Markdown in the repository; no database to run).

hosting.justification: Free global CDN with unlimited static bandwidth on the free plan. Fit for this project: strong cost for Cloudflare Pages (priority 5); well suited to content site projects; strong time to market for Cloudflare Pages (priority 4); serves pre-built static files from a CDN.

alternatives.why_not: Scored 0.7 points lower: the chosen option wins on priorities.performance (strong performance for Cloudflare Pages (priority 3)).
Scored 3.5 points lower: starts around $20/month against a $20 budget.

tradeoffs: Workers runtime is not Node.js; some libraries need adapters.

supporting.choice: GitHub Actions (build and deploy on push)
supporting.justification: Builds the static site on every push to main and deploys it; free for public repos.

alternatives.why_not: Equally fine; Actions keeps build steps in the repo.

supporting.choice: Free uptime check (e.g. UptimeRobot) + host analytics
supporting.justification: A static site only needs to know it is up; no servers to monitor.
